body:
QA run record for selector `priority:P0` of the 18.2.0 release test sweep, wave 2 (wave anchor #25807, card W2-C1). It supersedes the wave-1 P0 record #25812, which was run on the old head `6679644a`. The run used the `checklist-test` skill and followed `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `756220c4a7adcbb1228864607cb4b6a1ca486dc0`, checked out detached and pinned for the whole run. The tree was clean before and after (`git status --short` empty). `/api/v1/health` reports `version: 18.1.0` because the tree is unreleased.
- **Build:**
  - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: exit 0, 22 s.
  - `pnpm build --concurrency=2`: 119/119 tasks, 0 cached, 9 m 25 s, exit 0.
  - `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs`: green, 108 artifacts.
- **Console build line:** this is the first release-candidate run of the in-repo Console.
  - The Console was built in-repo from `ui/apps/console` at the same commit. `pnpm build` ran `@object-ui/console:build` as a cache miss (hash `1ab97949c097c590`).
  - `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` then ran 72/72 tasks (71 cached). `@objectstack/console:build:dist` copied `ui/apps/console/dist` to `packages/console/dist` and printed:
    - "✓ Single-zod canary: exactly one zod version literal {major:4,minor:6,patch:7}"
    - "✓ @objectstack/console dist ready (80644 KB) from ui/apps/console, with the tracked sdui.manifest.json"
  - Entry bundle: `assets/index-DkQSwG_q.js`. `diff -rq ui/apps/console/dist packages/console/dist` differs only in `sdui.manifest.json`, by design (the tracked manifest is copied over).
  - There is no `.objectui-sha` pin; that route is retired.
- **`stale-console-bundle` is ruled out explicitly**, on two grounds:
  - The served dist was built in this run from this commit's `ui/` tree.
  - On every console-serving boot (ports 42206, 42320, 42401–42404, 42501–42503), `GET /_console/` answered 200. The served `/_console/assets/index-DkQSwG_q.js` has the same sha256 as `packages/console/dist/assets/index-DkQSwG_q.js` (`c9c69e49…`). The CLI resolves `@objectstack/console` to `packages/console` in this tree, and no `../objectui` sibling exists.
- **App:** `examples/app-showcase`.
  - Canonical boot: `OS_PORT=PORT setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:SCRATCH/ITEM.db`.
  - Every boot had its own port (lanes 42101–42599) and its own file DB. Servers were stopped by process group.
  - Items that author metadata or need an unshared app dir booted from `tar` scratch copies: `cli.dev-boot-contract`, the ceremony, MCP and studio legs.
  - Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) plus the showcase seed, 132 rows.
  - Walled leg: `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only` through `os dev`, from the stock tree. It printed `Tenancy: isolated` with Organizations mounted and no FATAL or DEGRADED line.
- **Fixtures provisioned by the runners:**
  - A v17 SQLite from npm `@objectstack/cli@17.7.0`. This image's npm 10.9.4 needs `--legacy-peer-deps`; all 53 `@objectstack` packages resolved to 17.7.0. Booted with `os start` in an empty dir, plus one sign-up: 74 tables, 130 rows.
  - A local Postgres 16 (scram-sha-256), TCP only, on 42290.
  - Personas minted by invite + sign-up, or by admin create-user + change-password. Each identity was proven by `get-session` before use.
  - **One fixture write was made outside HTTP:** the walled org owner's `manage_metadata` grant row, which `access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only` fixtures prescribe. It was written directly into the run's own `walled.db`, after both HTTP grant doors were measured refusing it (403).
- **Tier 1:**
  - Every framework file named in the items' `automated.ref` ran as one vitest invocation per owning package at `--maxWorkers=1`, serialised across runners with a file lock.
  - The Playwright pin `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` ran against live :42403 with `OS_TEST_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`.
  - Every pin was green.
- **Date and container:** 2026-10-27 (UTC), Linux, 4 vCPU / 15 GB.
- **Runners:** one orchestrator plus 5 parallel runner subagents: api ×2, cli ×1, browser/mixed ×2. Each runner worked through its own lane sequentially.
